evidence:
Scope and authority: independently reviewed only quality point 30. Read the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx with openpyxl: Quality Checks!A31:D31 and Internal Quality Checks!A31:D31 both say any 'rejects / hides / absent' check needs a matching success case so a totally broken app cannot earn it. No extra annotation cells appeared in the internal row. Frozen workbook SHA256 is 6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f. Harbor references/quality-checks.md:127-129 includes unchanged legs; qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md, 'A negative needs a successful control' and 'Independent credit takes precedence over flow grouping', require actual successful facts rather than sibling pass flags.

Bindings: independently hashed all 50 frozen task files against manifest.json inputs.task with zero mismatches. The raw RESULTS.json hash equals the evidence index's ec88c00c12336257196e209f427a40690b76b4d3fc7f283656bc67735cf1bc09. Independently verified all 22 raw-recorded golden app hashes and all 20 driver hashes with zero mismatches. Frozen functional judge SHA256 4b56232c522d4cf1193430fc2200e7d68e53e941e83ee0f13d8e2e56fe66e18c and prompt SHA256 adc53fbb8d376a7c5396d395ffd72360620b8735231e46dfb87fac8da328aa42 exactly match raw evidence.

All dimension judge files and prompts were inspected, including all 64 functional descriptors and their protocols. The binding rule in tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:25 is 'Before a negative probe establish its meaningful successful control or the explicitly permitted actual handoff.' Line 100 adds that a never-working preview, never-accepted valid request or never-populated console cannot prove suppression/refusal/preservation/clearing; actual shared control facts are required independently of sibling verdicts. This is operative criterion interpretation, not reliance on the global gate alone.

Execution controls: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:70,77,84,98,105,112 pair fresh-state/CSS inertness/timer cancellation/completed Stop/pending Stop/supersession with actual prior execution. Their detailed controls in prompt.md:128-149 require observed script and handler markers, retained enabled button plus ordinary click after CSS, a matching timer actually firing once, and a second observed pending timer. Lines 156-161 require actual completed-preview handlers before Stop. Lines 168-180 require the exact uncancelled four-second callback to emit its delayed marker and thrown error before either cancellation trial; a pending indicator alone is explicitly insufficient. Rollback protocols record an actually completed render and a real failure/Stop, not an empty preview: lines 168-180,234-259,265-341,448-456. The finite braced/unbraced/Promise loops compute 3,4,3 before infinite-loop checks; the short nested timer must complete before its long counterpart is timed out.

Boundary controls: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:188-198 proves own-document DOM/log execution and recovery around all four denied parent-document/storage operations, while permitting legitimate app title changes. Lines 204-208 and the executable recipe at 29-95 require successful exact-URL fetch AND image transport controls, visible refusal for each separate authored run, unchanged delivery counts and successful ordinary recovery; failed setup cannot prove protection. Lines 214-228 first execute harmless scope words, or a permitted ordinary successful fallback, before five individually refused unsupported-family probes and recovery. A blanket-dead runner cannot satisfy these controls.

State controls: prompt.md:367-371 populates console rows through actual Runs before Clear; 377-383 requires an automatically executed authored edit before either Auto-run off outcome and deliberate Run of the exact pending source after each absence window. judge.toml:294 and 301 explicitly state 'A dead Auto-run feature cannot pass; correct debounce-reset behaviour is not a prerequisite.' Save/load canary controls in prompt.md:397-403 demonstrate valid monitor updates and fresh reads, leave five seconds for the source-as-text operations, then perform the exact current monitor update and observe changed source plus revision. Stale-refusal controls in 421-426 require successful newer writes in both editor directions; title controls in 432-436 require valid creation/update and unused-title recovery for creation/update collision and empty-title refusal. No absent record or broken endpoint earns these negatives. The example remains unchanged only after a separate edited copy is actually saved and reloaded (121); restart preservation uses actual saved records and current-revision writes (409-415); theme preservation requires two actual switches and existing successful preview/console content (442; judge.toml:413).

Other dimensions: Render judge.toml:23-27 requires newly authored DOM AND console execution; Constraints judge.toml:25-29 requires a new successful UI write and exact clean-context readback. Their failures cannot earn credit from empty/static surfaces. Polish judge.toml:23 requires each narrow-screen pane to be reached and used before the no-hidden-controls claim; :50 requires actual focused controls; :68 explicitly populates console before a Clear-based feedback case. P02 prompt.md:43-49 uses actual saved/example source and real keyboard navigation. Visual criteria assess observed rendered surfaces and expressly assign the lowest anchor to unavailable/missing surfaces (visual prompt.md:44-49), not credit for absence of visual problems.

Raw observations inspected independently, without treating aggregate passed flags as proof: RESULTS.json facts.S02.css_inert_copy.evidence records script/handler counts 1/1 before and 1/1 after; facts.S02.css_pending_timer_cancelled records css-timer-fired-1, then css-timer-start-2 with no second fired marker. facts.S04.supersede_pending.evidence.positive_control records delayed=1, errors=1 and a 4002.6 ms error status; subsequent delayed/error counts stay at baseline. facts.S03.completed_stop records click/key/input counts 1/1/1 both before and after Stop and a successful recovery. facts.S09.literal_loop_deadline records all three finite values and later approximately five-second terminations. facts.S17.autorun_debounce.evidence.first.value records auto-fired after 559.049 ms; both off-state records have 3000 ms observation windows with stable prior bodies, while facts.S17.manual_run_independent_of_autorun records manual-off and queued-source marker counts increasing from 0 to 1. facts.S07.snippet_network_boundary records successful text nonce and image width 2, two baseline deliveries, visible refusals for separate fetch/Image runs, and final deliveries still 2. facts.S21.save_load_execution_canary records monitor revision 3 unchanged through create/update/load/settled, then the matching successful control advances it to revision 4. Relevant executed-driver sections were read to confirm these observations came from actual actions.

Adversarial source walkthroughs: a dead Auto-run feature with working manual Run is denied both off-state outcomes by the explicitly mandatory automatic-execution control; a no-op timer implementation is denied pending cancellation/deadline outcomes by observed matching callbacks; a save endpoint that rejects every write cannot establish stale/title refusal; a dead Clear button with an initially empty console cannot establish clearing. No credible false pass survives the specified controls. A conforming app that removes or disables its completed preview on Stop is explicitly accepted after its live pre-Stop control (prompt.md:160; judge.toml:98). A conforming app that proactively prevents stale Save is accepted with actual conflict/draft evidence and separate observed-format replay (prompt.md:423). These are analytical witnesses, not newly executed app variants.

Run scope: relevant scripted golden observations support the presence and usability of the controls; no new browser/provider/Docker run was performed. The scripts are not the configured LLM judge, an Oracle score, hosted QC or a measured judge runtime. Run verdict PARTIAL denotes that limitation; point 30's authored-control design is supported, and no point-30 defect or required point-30 missing measurement was found.
